verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਝਗਰੋ ਮਿਟਤ ਰੋਸ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਡੰਡੁ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: haar maanee jhagaro miTat ros maare sai rasain hui poT ddaare laagat na dda(n)dd jag jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Accepting defeat ends all discords. Shedding anger gives much peace. If we discard the results/income of all our deeds/business, we are never taxed. This fact is known to the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਮਤ ਨਵਨ ਥਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: haume abhimaan asathaan uooche naeh jal nimat navan thal jal pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The heart where ego and pride dwells is like a high ground where no water can accumulate. Lord cannot stay either.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਤਰਹਰ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)g saraba(n)g tarahar hot hai charan taa te charanaamirat charan ren maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Feet are located at the lowest end of the body. That is why the dust of the feet and the foot wash are regarded sacred and thus respected.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਜਗ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੮੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise har bhagat jagat mai ni(n)maree bhoot jag pag lag masatak paravaaneeaai ||288||

en.bdb: So is the devotee and worshipper of God who is sans pride and full of humility. The whole world falls at his feet and consider their forehead blessed. (288)
